readme: Riverside County motion_type/outcome cross-entry leak fixture (#3638). Synthetic two-entry calendar text. Entry 1 (CVRI2500001) has a substantive motion (Motion for Summary Judgment, GRANTED). Entry 2 (CVRI2500002) is a calendar-only line with no motion description and no ruling content. The contaminated_llm_output shows what a leak-prone LLM produces: entry 2 carries forward motion_type and outcome from entry 1. The expected_clean_output shows the correct behavior: entry 2 has null motion_type and null outcome because its text supports neither.

Tentative Rulings for April 28, 2026
Department RI01
Judge Jane Smith

1.
CVRI2500001
WILLIAMS vs ACME CORP
Motion for Summary Judgment by Defendant

Tentative Ruling: GRANT Defendant's Motion for Summary Judgment.

Legal Standard: A motion for summary judgment shall be granted if all the papers submitted show that there is no triable issue as to any material fact and that the moving party is entitled to judgment as a matter of law. (Code Civ. Proc., § 437c, subd. (c).)

Analysis: Defendant has demonstrated that Plaintiff cannot establish the essential element of causation. Plaintiff's expert declaration is conclusory and lacks foundation. The motion is GRANTED.

2.
CVRI2500002
JONES vs ADAMS

Tentative Ruling: No tentative ruling — a hearing will be conducted.
